clips.title: The story
paras: Elder Bronzebeard is an ancient spirit of the earthen who appears in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge during the Lunar Festival. Bearing the name of the clan that rules the city, his spectral presence serves as a bridge between modern dwarves and their stony stone-hewn ancestors.

Appearing near the pool in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Elder Bronzebeard does not wear the flesh of modern dwarves; instead, his ghostly form is that of an earthen, the ancient race forged from living stone by the Titans. Dwarven scholars and explorers are only beginning to uncover their origins through excavations across Khaz Modan and beyond, making this spirit's presence a striking living relic. His very name and visage suggest he is a direct ancestor of the Bronzebeard clan, standing silent witness to how far his stoneborn progeny have evolved.
